title: Protein Language Model-Boosted Prediction of Isoelectric Point
authors: Fangfang Luo; Xiangxiang Lu; Zhitao Cai; Hongyu Lin; Yandong Huang
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白语言模型结合pKa优化预测蛋白质等电点，虽涉及蛋白序列和结构相关性质，但核心问题是等电点预测而非结构计算建模，方法上仅用序列嵌入，与蛋白质结构计算课题关联中等。
abstract: pH plays a key role in many biological processes. When the solution pH equals the isoelectric point (pI) of a protein, the protein carries zero net charge, which minimizes its solubility and thus promotes aggregation. Here we present ESMpI, a sequence-based protein pI predictor that combines optimized pKa values of seven ionizable residue types and two terminals with embeddings from a pre-trained protein language model. Benchmarked against experimental protein pI values, ESMpI outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, including structure-based approaches that derive the pI of a protein from residue-specific pKa calculations. Finally, ESMpI requires only sequence information, making it well suited for high-throughput proteomescale analyses and protein engineering.
abstract_zh: pH在许多生物过程中扮演关键角色。当溶液pH值等于蛋白质的等电点（pI）时，蛋白质携带零净电荷，这最小化其溶解度，从而促进聚集。在此，我们提出ESMpI，一种基于序列的蛋白质pI预测器，它结合了七种可电离残基类型和两个末端的优化pKa值，以及来自预训练蛋白质语言模型的嵌入。与实验蛋白质pI值进行基准测试，ESMpI优于其他最先进的方法，包括从残基特异性pKa计算中推导蛋白质pI的结构基础方法。最后，ESMpI仅需序列信息，使其非常适合高通量蛋白质组规模分析和蛋白质工程。
